title: Modded Discs to CDs (Unofficial)
description: Makes the discs from various mods into CDs. An unofficial addon to a different texture pack.
body:
The second texture pack that is disc related. 

This is an **UNOFFICIAL** addon to a different texture pack. 

[**THIS IS THE ORIGINAL**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cd-music-disc-countxd)

It annoyed me that all the modded discs werent CDs, so i fixed it myself!

3 mods are included so far.

- Biomes O' Plenty [(link)](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty)

- Dungeons Now Loading [(link)](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeon-now-loading)

- BetterEnd [(link)](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend)
